essence: After completing the rite, the knower should give the collected ghee to a woman.
By offering fragrant flowers in the fire, one obtains the desired wealth.
One should recite the mantra formula beginning with Om and obeisance to Shiva and Narayani.
The mantra is attributed to Vyasa as seer, Kriti as meter, and Ganga as deity.
The goddess should be visualized as four-armed, three-eyed, and adorned with all ornaments.
